title: Protected Asservat installation identity settings v1
description: Content of identity.json in the Helm-rendered settings ConfigMap (ADR-335 D4, D14). Groups are read by name from groupsClaim and valid until the access token expires; any authenticated human of a registered client is eligible unless requiredGroups restricts sign-in. administrators is the only identity list; everyone else gets access through AccessBindings, ClusterAccessBindings and PermissionSources. Not a CRD or public API. Lists are not capped; the ConfigMap size limit (1 MiB) bounds them.

groupsClaim.description: Token claim carrying group names (Keycloak: full paths such as /payments).

usernameClaim.description: Claim shown and searched for people; sub stays the internal key.

requiredGroups.description: Optional: only members of one of these groups may sign in (for a realm shared with other organizations). Omitted: every authenticated user of the issuer and client is eligible.

administrators.description: Installation administrators by group name or subject. They hold every administrative right including privacy processing and cluster registration.

approvals.description: Installation approval settings (ADR-249, ADR-335 D5). stepUp is optional and off by default; when set, approving additionally requires the token's signed acr to be one of acrValues and auth_time at most maxAgeSeconds old.

policyGrants.description: Policy grant periods (ADR-335 D6): administrator-set default (90 days), maximum (default 365 days) and renewal notice (default 14 days before expiry); an approver renews in place. An accepted lower maximum clamps earlier-issued grants from their original issuedAt; raising it does not extend them.
